contract.intended_consumer: Brian and agents installing the portable governed-repository framework
contract.outcome: A governed repository gets a default-on derived navigation wiki and one master off switch that disables governed controls without deleting installed state or losing per-control modes.

canonical_journey.starting_state: Plan 128 is merged and one exact plan-bound implementation claim is selection-pending.
canonical_journey.input: The canonical installer, governed-repo audit, configuration template, existing Plan 63 docstring wiki, and a disposable Git consumer.
canonical_journey.action: Implement the typed effective profile, install it into the consumer, exercise default-on, master-off, re-enable, stale wiki detection, and refresh.
canonical_journey.observable_result: Installer and audit agree on effective state; master-off blocks nothing and removes nothing; re-enable restores modes; wiki freshness fails then passes after regeneration.
canonical_journey.failure_signal: Absent config resolves off, disabled controls block, modes are rewritten, wiki is called authority, or the consumer journey is not reproducible.
